description: Inference: predict.py follows the checkpoint's recorded frozen integration grid (default auto; all existing checkpoints -> native, outputs unchanged) with an explicit --integration-grid native|fine override for run and check-streaming. Fine mode in NEW runner methods (StreamedRunner._deform_fine, UnchunkedRunner._deform_fine) covering the default plan, --levels plans (skipped / truncated levels), TTA flip8 (via the existing _deform_stage / _deform_stage_freeing) and affine+deform. Plan decision D5, item 4. Depends on FEAT-001 (cascade.integrate_frozen_at, FrozenStage.svf, FrozenChain.svfs, integration_grid factory kwarg).
steps: Read plan.md D5 + Digest (inference bullets) and FEAT-001 findings.

inference/loader.py: load_model(checkpoint_path, branches, precision='checkpoint', device='gpu', integration_grid='auto'). INTEGRATION_GRIDS_CLI = ('auto', 'native', 'fine'); invalid -> LoaderError. checkpoint grid = (config.get('cascade') or {}).get('frozen_integration_grid') or args.get('frozen_integration_grid') or 'native' (validate in cascade.INTEGRATION_GRIDS, else LoaderError). used: auto -> 'fine' if checkpoint grid == 'current' else 'native'; explicit values as given; explicit != auto-value -> logger.warning('--integration-grid %s overrides the checkpoint's frozen_integration_grid %s (experiment: the cascade was trained the other way)'). Build frozen stages with integration_grid='current' if used == 'fine' else 'native'. knobs['integration_grid'] = {'checkpoint': <native|current>, 'used': <native|fine>}. LoadedModel.__init__ gains integration_grid='native' (validated in ('native', 'fine')); ValueError if a frozen stage's integration_grid does not match ('fine' <-> 'current'); knobs default dict (tests constructing LoadedModel directly) gains the same key.

inference/cli.py: in _common, only when branches=True (run, check-streaming; not linear-eval), add --integration-grid choices auto|native|fine default auto with help 'auto = the checkpoint's recorded frozen_integration_grid (native for older runs; current -> fine); fine = frozen SVFs integrated at each level's grid as in a --frozen-integration-grid current training, outputs at 1 mm'. inference/predict.py _load(args): pass integration_grid=getattr(args, 'integration_grid', 'auto').

inference/runner.py StreamedRunner: in run() and _run_sel(), when self.loaded.integration_grid == 'fine' and dfm is not None, call self._deform_fine(n, src, A, sink, summary, phases, free_src) instead of _deform / _deform_sel (native calls untouched). _deform_fine uses plan = self.plan or LVS.plan(self.levels, None); T = self.loaded.model_cfg.integration_steps; svfs = [] list of (level, store name). Loop lv over self.levels: truncated -> break; skipped -> mark had_skip and continue; eng = self._engine(lv); is_last = lv == plan.last. input_fn: no svfs and no had_skip -> pool(src); no svfs but had_skip -> self._prewarp_deform_zero_fn(lv); else a cached tf.function body(x1, *v_chunks) = diffeo.warp(_pool_to(x1, lv), CS.integrate_frozen_at(list(zip(levels, v_chunks)), lv, T)[0], lean=self.lean). prev_fn: only for is_last: no svfs and no skip -> None; no svfs but skip -> self._zero_fields_fn(lv); else a cached fn returning integrate_frozen_at(..., lv, T)[:2]. Non-last levels: sink stores d['v'] into self.store under 'FG_v%d' (alloc on first chunk, float32) and appends (lv, name) to svfs; last level: a fine level sink: U1, U1_inv = (d['u'], d['u_inv']) if lv == 1 else a cached fn integrate_frozen_at(svf chunks + [(lv, d['v'])], 1, T)[:2]; ckpt fields (u_ckpt, u_inv_ckpt, v, v_raw) only when lv == self.level (same rule as _level_sink_sel); call sink(i0, i1, self._res(A slice, fields)). Reuse _deform_masks(n, src, plan.run), _deform_stage_freeing and the src-freeing wrapper of _deform; _record(summary, lv, 'deform', eng); free every FG_v store name after the last level. Set summary['integration_grid'] = 'fine' in the fine path only; native summaries keep their current keys.

inference/runner.py UnchunkedRunner: when integration_grid == 'fine' and dfm is not None, run() / _run_sel() call self._deform_fine(src, n, phases) returning the same fields dict as _deform_sel. Level 4 checkpoint (frozen None): out = model(x) (as _deform); U1 = out u if lv == 1 else integrate_frozen_at([(4, v)], 1, T) (plan must be the full plan as today). Else: frozen_body(x) returns the svfs dict via frozen.svfs (chain: skip4 = tf.constant(True) if 4 in plan.skipped; FrozenStage: {4: frozen.svf(x)}); drop skipped levels and levels after plan.last; prior at lv = integrate_frozen_at(svf list, lv, T) if the list is non-empty else zeros (skip semantics); if plan.last != lv: U1 = integrate_frozen_at(list, 1, T) (zeros if empty), ckpt fields None; else body(x, U, U_inv) as today (warp, model, compose_cascade) and U1 = (u, u_inv) if lv == 1 else integrate_frozen_at(list + [(lv, v)], 1, T). Use self._fn keys distinct from the native ones (e.g. ('deform_fine_frozen', n, plan.selected)).

Tests in tests/test_fine_grid_integration.py class TestInferenceFine (reuse tests.test_predict_runner RunnerCase / _level2 / _level4 / _collect and tests.test_predict_streaming._images; tiny models): (a) level-2 LoadedModel(integration_grid='fine', frozen current): streamed == unchunked (U1, U1_inv, u_ckpt, v; tolerances of test_predict_runner); u_ckpt equals the trainer formula compose_cascade(frozen.deform(x2)['U'], ..., model(prewarp_deform(x2, U))); U1 equals integrate_frozen_at([(4, v4), (2, v2)], 1, T); (b) --levels plans 4 (truncation: U1 == integrate_frozen_at([(4, v4)], 1, T)) and 2 (skip 4, allow untrained: equals the zero-prior reference) in both runners; (c) level-4 checkpoint with fine: U1 == exp at L1 of up(up(v4)); (d) TTA with flips = TTA.IDENTITY_ONLY in fine mode equals no TTA, and flip8 runs finite; (e) affine+deform fine runs (streamed == unchunked); (f) level-1 chain fine (N 2, lean, tiny): streamed == unchunked and the level-1 model input equals prewarp_deform(x1, chain.deform(x1)['U']) with a current chain; (g) loader: a config.json without the key -> knobs used native and frozen native; with cascade.frozen_integration_grid 'current' -> fine; explicit native on it -> warning logged (assertLogs) and native frozen; invalid value -> LoaderError; LoadedModel mismatch -> ValueError; (h) cli: run / check-streaming accept --integration-grid, linear-eval rejects it.
